title: Service Charge, Included Service Hours and Clear-Down for Corporate Catering Service Agreement Levels
content:
Four figures govern what the brigade on site costs under a Corporate Catering Service Agreement.

1. The **service charge** is the percentage added to food and beverage on the order.
2. The **included service hours** are the on-site service hours carried in the service level, to one decimal place.
3. The **additional hour rate** is the billed rate for each further on-site service hour, in USD.
4. The **clear-down window** is the number of minutes after service during which the team returns to clear.

| Service level | Service charge | Included service hours | Additional hour rate | Clear-down window |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 0.0 per cent | 0.0 | 34.00 USD | 0 minutes |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 8.0 per cent | 0.0 | 36.50 USD | 30 minutes |
| Attended Buffet Account | 14.0 per cent | 3.0 | 38.50 USD | 60 minutes |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 20.0 per cent | 5.0 | 42.00 USD | 90 minutes |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 22.0 per cent | 6.0 | 52.00 USD | 120 minutes |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 18.0 per cent | 8.0 | 40.00 USD | 120 minutes |

**Basis Q&A.** *Which level carries the dearest hour?* The Executive Hospitality Catering Account, at 52.00 USD an hour, although it carries 6.0 included hours against the 8.0 of the Campus Catering Master Account, whose additional hour stands at 40.00 USD. *Where does a service charge of nothing appear?* Against the Drop-Off Catering Account alone, at 0.0 per cent; every other level carries a service charge of at least 8.0 per cent. *Do the clear-down windows differ at the top of the schedule?* The Executive Hospitality Catering Account and the Campus Catering Master Account both carry 120 minutes, the longest in the schedule.
